check_en: PDU A feed indicator is normal
PDU B feed indicator is normal
Breakers are seated and labeled
No hot plugs, discoloration, or burning smell
check_zh: 插头无过热、变色或焦糊味

Hot-aisle temperature is within the site limit
check_zh: 热通道温度未超过现场上限

check_zh: 精密空调或列间空调运行且无告警

check_zh: UPS 在线，未转入电池放电

check_en: No UPS alarm or fault lamp
check_zh: UPS 无告警灯或故障灯

check_en: Load percent is within the site limit
check_zh: 负载百分比未超过现场上限

check_en: Bypass switch is in the normal position
check_zh: 旁路开关处于正常位置

Rear door is closed and latched

check_zh: 机柜标签与平面图一致

check_zh: 弯曲半径看起来符合线缆规范

check_zh: 没有未贴标的临时线缆

Switch system LED is green

check_zh: 没有说不清的琥珀色或红色端口灯

No active audible alarm
Fire panel shows normal
No trouble or supervisory lamp

check_zh: 探测器和喷头没有被挡住

check_zh: 手动释放装置铅封完好

check_zh: 本机房未完成的作业已写在备注里
